dct_description_sm: 1) To assess the effect on the immune system of rats following developmental exposure to a complex organochlorine mixture, similar to that found in the Arctic aquatic food-chain, by measuring: a) cytokine gene expression in splenic DC and peripheral blood mononuclear cells; b) complement system components C2 and C3. 2) To determine the effects of the OC mixture and its main components on the expression of specific maturation markers (CD86, MHCII, CCR6 and CCR7) in a monocytic cell line (THP-1).
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Traditional diet
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Inuit population
dct_title_s: Perinatal Organochlorine Exposure in Rats: Effects on Humoral and Cellular Immune Parameters
